versionStatus: PHASE_9C_QUEUE_DISPOSITIONS_ROUND — 1.38.0 delivers the plan's slice 4 (Admin experience) first carry: the WRITE-CAPABLE QUEUE DISPOSITION surface (schema 6 UNCHANGED — ZERO migration, ZERO DDL): (1) THE PURE DISPOSITION MODULE qd1 (NEW src/domain/publishing/queue-disposition.ts): the TOTAL typed decision over the REAL pol1 vocabulary — pending/retry_wait/failed => cancellable (exactly the pol1 cancel rows), claimed/publishing => refused in_flight (a worker may hold the lease), published => refused already_published (the 8.4 supersede flow owns it), dead_letter/cancelled/superseded => refused terminal (pol1: NO exits), unknown strings fail typed; the ONE disposition is the pol1 CANCEL — a STOP, NEVER a resend (no retry-now disposition exists on this surface; the only re-send paths in the whole product remain the ADR-0032 recorded-evidence heal and the 8.4 correction supersede flow); the whole-token argument grammar (the R1.18.1/9B discipline: forbidden-whitespace pattern, 128-byte bound, the C0/DEL scan — a grammar failure BEFORE any query could exist); (2) THE FENCED DURABLE WRITE cancelPublicationById in publication-outbox-store.ts: UPDATE publications SET status='cancelled', lease/claimed cleared, updated_at WHERE id AND status IN ('pending','retry_wait','failed') — the rowcount is the authority (the auto-approval house shape); last_error deliberately NOT overwritten (a parked row keeps its classifier code as the epistemic record — the cancel's story lives in the audit); rowcount 0 => the honest not_found vs not_cancellable with ZERO effect; rowcount 1 => ONE audit event (audit_events actor_type 'admin' per the migration-0001 CHECK vocabulary, action queue_publication_cancelled, DETERMINISTIC id queue-cancel:<publicationId>, metadata = dispositionVersion/priorStatus/permission only — never document content, never destinations); (3) THE SURFACES: /queue (no args) stays the EXACT Phase 9A read screen; /queue <publicationId> is the NEW bounded detail view gated by the INDEPENDENT fail-closed ADMIN_QUEUE_WRITE_ENABLED (default 'false', invalid-present = disabled, shipped 'false' everywhere) — while OFF the one-argument form keeps the EXACT Phase 9A invalid-usage response (the richer surface never leaks); the detail renders identity/status/priority/attempts/schedule facts/stable codes ONLY (never draft content, never destinations) with the honest disposition state line ALWAYS present; the cancel button is minted ONLY when BOTH the verdict is cancellable AND the caller holds publication.cancel (RBAC chief_editor/owner) — ONE opaque single-use user-bound 15-minute token (the Phase 2A admin_action_tokens machinery) issued DURABLY before the message is sent; (4) THE ACTION-AWARE TOKEN DISPATCHER: while the write flag is ON the router emits action_token_callback for EVERY a: callback and the ingress PRE-READS the token's server-side action WITHOUT consuming — admin_post.* tokens reach the UNCHANGED admin-post service, queue.cancel_publication tokens reach the disposition service, anything else answers the honest invalid with NOTHING consumed (a foreign/future token can never be burned by the wrong service); while OFF the callback routing is byte-identical legacy; (5) THE CALLBACK FLOW (the admin-post confirm shape): guarded single-use consume bound to ONE user, the permission RE-CHECKED at callback time (a revoked holder is refused — the token burns, the row does not move, the audit stays silent), the fenced store write (a row claimed between view and click answers the honest not-cancellable with ZERO effect), the audit event on the applied path; the disposition NEVER sends and NEVER touches the delivery evidence (asserted on the SQL texts). RED-first held: tests/unit/queue-disposition.test.ts (16) + tests/integration/admin-queue-disposition.test.ts (34 REAL-D1, registered in test:db) written FIRST with real RED (cannot-resolve-module on BOTH) then GREEN; TWO in-round findings fixed honestly (the audit actor_type 'telegram' violated the migration-0001 CHECK vocabulary — corrected to 'admin', the human-admin surface actor; the test-side duplicate updateIds/seeding loops); the flag family pins the independence (write ON does not imply read ON, and vice versa). GATES: npm run check exit 0 and npm run test:db exit 0 on the delivery tree — exact counts in PROJECT_STATUS.md. HONEST CARRY: the album-draft CAPTURING side (the admin surface gathering a media group from real Telegram updates), the zod v4 TRACKED migration and the rights-EVIDENCE model (OD-010: scope/expiry/attribution/write surface) stay carried; LIVE surfaces BLOCKED_LIVE (Posidon only).
